summary: Kerjo v4 regression: undo swipe + unread badge + applicants + online/phone in chat + interview scheduling + screening questions + phone on jobs + no-face avatars. Backend: 45/45 pytest pass (added 12 new tests: TestUndoSwipe, TestUnreadCount, TestGetMatchOnlinePhone, TestJobWithPhoneAndScreening, TestApplicants, TestSchedule, TestNoFaceInMatches). Verified: (a) POST /api/swipe/undo removes the swipe so the target reappears in /api/workers; (b) unread flow — sending a message from B increments unread for A on /api/matches and increments /api/matches/unread-count; POST /api/matches/{id}/read zeroes both; (c) GET /api/matches/{id} exposes online:bool and per-viewer phone (job_phone for worker, worker_phone for employer); (d) POST /api/jobs accepts phone + screening_questions and POST /api/swipe accepts screening_answers, which show up on /api/applicants alongside matched:false initially; (e) after B right-swipes wp_<worker>, applicants row switches to matched:true with match_id; (f) POST /api/matches/{id}/schedule inserts a kind='schedule' message with pending status and proposed_by=uid; POST /api/matches/{id}/schedule/{sid}/respond flips status to accepted/declined and appends a system message 'menerima'/'menolak'; (g) /api/matches for SOLO_TOKEN, tokA and tokB have NO pravatar/randomuser/unsplash URLs in match.image — legacy migration from iteration_3 landed. Frontend web (mobile viewport 390x844): confirmed home-screen loads, no face imagery, mode-work/mode-hire toggle works. Undo (Batal) — pass-button click reveals undo-button, tapping undo hides it and card reappears. Hiring mode shows applicants-shortcut ('Pelamar') and post-shortcut ('Pasang Kerja') both navigating correctly. Applicants screen renders with 'Belum ada pelamar' when empty (solo). Post job form has input-phone + add-question yielding input-question-0/1/2 with remove-question-* and the add-question button hides after 3. Chat unread badge on the Chat tab shows a numeric count (verified '12' as tokkerjo01 with /api/matches/unread-count -> 12). Chat screen for a real match with worker A shows 'sedang aktif' green dot after tokA is-online (last_seen<120s). Schedule sheet opens with sched-kind-{Wawancara/Tes-Asesmen/Hari-Pertama}, sched-time-* chips, sched-note, submit-schedule; posting adds a bubble in chat identified by testID schedule-<sid>; earlier schedule shows 'Diterima' after respond. No red screens; only benign warnings ('shadow*' style deprecation, Animated useNativeDriver on web).

minor.issue: phone is snapshotted at match creation from profile.phone / job.phone. If a worker or employer updates their phone AFTER the match is created, the chat call button will remain hidden because worker_phone/job_phone on the match doc are not refreshed. Suggest resolving phone at read-time from the current profile/job doc (fallback to snapshot).

issues: Badge is styled via tabBarBadgeStyle only — cannot be selected by data-testid, only by numeric text content. OK for humans but tests must fall back to /api/matches/unread-count. Not blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: Web console repeatedly logs: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/cards.tsx and /app/frontend/src/components/swipe-deck.tsx.

Warning: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing. Falling back to JS-based animation.' Non-blocking on web; harmless on native. Gate with Platform.OS==='web' ? false : true.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Resolve match.phone at read time from the underlying profile/job (fallback to snapshot) so late-added phones enable the chat call button without recreating the match.
OPTIONAL: Replace deprecated shadow* style props with boxShadow (or Platform.select) to silence console noise on web.
OPTIONAL: Gate useNativeDriver behind Platform.OS==='web' ? false : true.
NOTE (carryover): server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'); migrate to FastAPI lifespan().
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 872 lines — well past the 700-line split threshold. Split into routers/{auth,browse,matches,schedule,profile,uploads,swipes,applicants}.

create_real_match snapshots worker_phone/job_phone/worker_avatar into the match doc; any later profile/job edits (photo, phone) will not be reflected in existing matches. Consider read-time resolution.
In /api/matches, per-match unread is computed with N+1 queries (one count per match). Fine at current scale, but consider a single aggregation as match count grows.
POST /api/matches/{id}/schedule returns ALL messages; sender uses uid; for consistency with send_message use the same shape. OK for now.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (added 7 new test classes / 12 cases: TestUndoSwipe, TestUnreadCount, TestGetMatchOnlinePhone, TestJobWithPhoneAndScreening, TestApplicants, TestSchedule, TestNoFaceInMatches)

success_rate.frontend: 100% — every tested flow works: undo button, hire-mode shortcuts, applicants screen navigation, post-job phone + 3 screening questions with add/remove, chat unread badge (12), chat 'sedang aktif' when other party online, schedule sheet posting + accept/decline bubble, no face imagery.

seed_data_creation: Same as iteration_3: session-scoped fixture creates fresh user_At_<rand>/user_Bt_<rand> pair with tokAt/tokBt. Iteration 4 additionally creates a TEST_CV Screening job under tokB with phone + 2 screening questions and a right-swipe by SOLO_TOKEN carrying screening_answers ['3 tahun','Senin']; teardown removes user/session/profile/jobs/swipes/matches for the pair. testtoken_kerjo_123, tokA, tokB unchanged.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -o addopts='' -v (avoid xdist LoadScope — shared class state on S. real_match_id).  New tests depend on TestRealMatch running first because S.real_match_id is used by TestUnreadCount/TestGetMatchOnlinePhone/TestSchedule. For frontend, set kerjo_session_token via localStorage as testtoken_kerjo_123 for solo browsing or tokA/tokB for real-match flows. To exercise 'sedang aktif' hit /api/auth/me with the OTHER user's token first so their last_seen is <120s. Chat call button only appears when match.phone is non-empty (currently snapshotted at match creation).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no reproducible bug this iteration. Only minor design note: match.phone is a snapshot, not resolved at read time. This is a data-freshness concern, not a defect.
